card.name: Digits inside reference numbers
card.fires_on: Digits, hyphens and decimal points in the middle of long identifier numbers such as ISBN, ISSN, DOI, PubMed IDs and dates in citations. It also fires on a few ordinary words in descriptive sentences.

modes.label: Inside citation numbers
modes.description: A digit or hyphen partway through an ISBN, ISSN, DOI or PubMed ID.
modes.example: Harris, eds.. Slavery in New York. New Press, 2005. ISBN 1-56584-9<<9>>7-3. - Gellman

modes.label: Inside numeric values
modes.description: A digit or decimal point inside a percentage or a year in a table or biography.
modes.example: azole n/N (%) Meropenem n/N (%) CrCl greater than 50 mL/min 312/366 (85<<.>>2) 355/4

modes.label: Scattered plain words
modes.description: Occasional ordinary words in descriptive sentences, such as "in" or "organizations".
modes.example: NHGRI. National Organization for Rare Disorders (NORD), a federation of voluntary health<< organizations>> dedicated to assisting those with rare disorders.

card.plain: It lights up on the middle digits of long reference codes like ISBNs and PubMed IDs.
